text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52656d

g.text: A task is scoped only when its SOP includes the admin-auth gate. Bars count traces; the right panel prevents repeated configs from looking like independent tasks.

g.text: ‘Before’ means the tool call precedes the first transfer call; auth result is read from the matching tool response.
